    Silverlink M&S crash RECAP: Two pedestrians seriously injured after vehicle smashes into foodhall in Wallsend

    A car has crashed into the entrance of the M&S foodhall at Silverlink retail park. Follow for updates

    Nicole Goodwin News Reporter
    Updated 22:21, 13 Oct 2026
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 8:01
    Instaread

    Two pedestrians have been seriously injured after a vehicle crashed through the entrance of an M&S foodhall at a Tyneside shopping park. A photo from the scene shows a car which appears to have reversed over a bollard and smashed through the doors of the Marks and Spencer store at Silverlink retail park in Wallsend, North Tyneside.

    Police, paramedics, fire crews and the Great North Air Ambulance Service were called to the scene and a police cordon remains in place.

    We will bring you updates as we receive them.

    Follow for updates.

    Key Events

    Two pedestrians seriously injured
    View Post

    View Post

    View Post
    13th Oct18:31 BST

    Full statement after Silverlink crash injures two

    Two pedestrians have been seriously injured after a vehicle crashed into an M&S foodhall, prompting a huge emergency response. Multiple people had to be assessed by medics following the incident at Silverlink retail park in Wallsend.

    Police, paramedics, firefighters and the Great North Air Ambulance Service were called to the scene shortly after 2.15pm today. A police cordon remains in place and drivers have been asked to avoid the area. Marks and Spencer is currently closed, the retailer said.

    Read our full story here

    David Huntley
    13th Oct18:23 BST

    RECAP after car smashes into M&S

    Shortly before 2.30pm today at car smashed into M&S at Silverlink Retail Park in North Tyneside.

    Along with police and firefighters, two ambulance crews, one duty officer, one rapid response paramedic, one specialist paramedic and one clinical team leader were called to the scene. The Great North Air Ambulance also landed.

    A man and woman, both aged in their 60s, were taken to the RVI.

    Northumbria Police confirmed that the driver, a woman in her 70s, remained at the scene of the collision.

    Anyone with information should contact police and quote NP-20261013-0624.

    David Huntley
    13th Oct17:19 BST

    Silverlink bosses supporting emergency services following the incident

    A spokesperson for Savills, the Property Manager of Silverlink Retail Park, said:

    We can confirm that an incident has taken place in the car park at Silverlink Retail Park. The site is supporting the emergency services as they respond to the incident.
    Nicole Goodwin
    ‌
    13th Oct17:09 BST

    Police issue new statement

    A Northumbria Police spokesperson said:

    At about 2.25pm today (Tuesday), we received a report of a collision within the Silverlink Retail Park in North Tyneside. It was reported that, for reasons yet to be established, a car collided with the front of a premises.Two pedestrians - a man and woman, both aged in their 60s – sustained serious injuries and were taken to hospital for treatment. The driver of the car – a woman in her 70s – remained at the scene to assist with police enquiries.Anyone who was in the area at the time and witnessed anything, including those with dashcam footage, should contact us online or via 101. Please quote reference: NP-20261013-0624.Emergency services remain at the scene, and a police cordon is in place, with drivers advised to avoid the area.
    Nicole Goodwin
    13th Oct17:00 BST

    Police appeal for witnesses

    Officers are asking anyone who was in the area at the time and witnessed anything, including those with dashcam footage, to contact Northumbria Police online or via 101, referencing: NP-20261013-0624.

    Nicole Goodwin
    13th Oct16:37 BST

    Driver remained at the scene of the collision

    Northumbria Police have confirmed that the driver, a woman in her 70s, remained at the scene of the collision.

    Nicole Goodwin

    13th Oct16:35 BST

    Tyne and Wear Fire and Rescue Service statement

    A Tyne and Wear Fire and Rescue Service spokesperson said:

    We can confirm that earlier this afternoon (Tuesday 13 October), three fire appliances attended an incident at a commercial premises in North Tyneside.An emergency call was received by our Fire Control Team at 2.21pm and crews from Byker, Tynemouth and Wallsend Community Fire Stations were dispatched to a retail park in Wallsend.Upon arrival, firefighters worked alongside colleagues from the North East Ambulance Service and Northumbria Police after a vehicle collided with the frontage of a shop unit.Firefighters left the scene at 3.26pm.
    Nicole Goodwin
    13th Oct16:34 BST

    Two pedestrians seriously injured

    Two pedestrians were seriously injured in the collision, Northumbria Police have confirmed.

    The man and woman, both aged in their 60s, were taken to RVI.

    Nicole Goodwin
    13th Oct16:31 BST

    Three fire engines sent to the scene

    Tyne and Wear Fire and Rescue Service dispatched three fire engines to the collision and spent almost an hour assisting police and paramedics at the scene.

    North East Ambulance Service statement

    We were called to a road traffic incident at the Silverlink Retail Park in Wallsend at 2.17pm on Tuesday 13th October 2026.We dispatched two ambulance crews, one duty officer, one rapid response paramedic, one specialist paramedic and one clinical team leader. We were also supported by Great North Air Ambulance Service (GNAAS). We assessed multiple patients at the incident and two patients were taken to the Royal Victoria Infirmary by road for further treatment.
